title: Constants manifest for one entry
description: The blobs this entry's recipes index, pinned by sha256, and the hash of each recipe file as it was added. The blobs themselves are never in git.

constants.description: Keyed by the name a graph's `constants` field points at.

file.description: File name of the blob. Resolved against whatever base a consumer serves the weights from when `url` is null.

usedBytes.description: Bytes the recipe actually indexes. Less than `bytes` when the blob ends in alignment padding.

url.description: Where the blob is published, or null while it is unpublished.

chunks.description: Optional byte ranges for a Range-served blob, so a reader holds one chunk instead of the whole thing. Boundaries need not respect constant boundaries.

recipeHashes.description: sha256 of each recipe file as stored here, plus where it was recorded from. A recipe that no longer hashes to this has been edited by hand, which is exactly what a recipe must never be.

sourceSha256.description: sha256 of the dump this file was copied from, if it differs.
